basis.zh-CN: 此画像根据公开岗位样本与行业说明整理，用作理解 AAA 团队中游戏设计岗位关注点的可复核参考。
basis.en: This profile synthesizes public job samples and industry guidance as a reviewable reference for game-design focus in AAA teams.

caveats.zh-CN: 这不是行业标准或唯一答案。岗位、团队结构、项目阶段和个人目标都会改变取舍；indie 与 solo 创作者的能力组合也会不同。
caveats.en: This is not an industry standard or the only answer. Roles, team structures, project phases, and personal goals change the tradeoffs; indie and solo creators also combine capabilities differently.
